integrity: Analytic proof adaptation; no numerical extrapolation or independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes finite graphs and strictly positive site-dependent longitudinal fields.
It does not establish optimality of the constant 1/4 or a bound for zero or mixed-sign fields.
A thermodynamic-limit statement requires a uniform positive lower bound on the minimum field along the sequence.
title: A graph-independent gap bound for inhomogeneous Lee–Yang fields
